newsitem.title: USA: Health Care files prospectus supplement.
newsitem.headline: Health Care files prospectus supplement.

text.p: Health Care REIT Inc said on Friday it has filed a prospectus supplement for a 2.2 million common share offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The shares have been offered by the company at a market price of $23.875 per share, the REIT said.

The company said it anticipated closing and delivery would occur on or about December 18. The company has also granted to underwriters an option to buy up to another 330,000 shares to cover over-allotments. Alex. Brown & Sons Inc is the manager of the underwriting group.
Proceeds would be used to invest in additional health care properties, the company said.
